name: Simon
bio: Simon, a Pharisee, invited Jesus to eat at his house. When a sinful woman came and wept at Jesus's feet, washing them with her tears and anointing them with ointment, Simon judged inwardly that Jesus could not be a prophet if he allowed such a woman to touch him. Jesus, perceiving his thoughts, told a parable of two debtors forgiven different amounts, and pointed out that Simon had shown him none of the hospitality the woman had shown through her tears, kisses, and ointment, declaring that her many sins were forgiven because she loved much (Luke 7:36-50). He is a different figure from Simon Peter and Simon the leper.
